o: Percy Jackson, the demigod son of Poseidon, is accused of stealing Zeus's lightning bolt. Percy embarks on an adventure with his friends Annabeth Chase and Grover Underwood to uncover the truth and rescue his mother from the Underworld.

eps.t: I Accidentally Vaporize My Pre-Algebra Teacher
eps.o: Expelled from school, Percy Jackson unravels who he is, confronting a world of gods and monsters.

eps.t: I Become Supreme Lord of the Bathroom
eps.o: Percy finds his place at Camp Half Blood, where he learns just how special his origins may be.

eps.t: We Visit the Garden Gnome Emporium
eps.o: Percy sets off on the quest to return Zeus' master bolt and stop a war between the gods.
Our heroes search for a refuge in St Louis, and come face to face with the mother of all monsters.
The quest deepens as Percy, Annabeth, and Grover are tasked with a favor from a fearsome opponent.

eps.t: We Take a Zebra to Vegas
eps.o: Percy, Annabeth, and Grover must resist the alluring draw of a casino that feels outside of time.

eps.t: We Find Out the Truth, Sort Of
eps.o: Our heroes journey across the Underworld, and bargain for their safety with the god of the dead.
Mount Olympus beckons... and Percy must face his greatest battle yet.
